profile.description: CGN Power Co., Ltd. operates and manages nuclear power stations and sells the electricity generated by these stations in the People’s Republic of China. It also provides construction, installation, design, and related technical services, as well as labor services. As of December 31, 2025, the company manages 28 nuclear power units with a total installed capacity of 31.838 GW. The company was incorporated in 2014 and is headquartered in Shenzhen, People’s Republic of China. CGN Power Co., Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of China General Nuclear Power Corporation.
